question: What auspicious qualities arise for the practitioner through this worship?
premises: The practitioner becomes worshipful to all beings.
The practitioner remains always healthy and well.
The practitioner attains complete good fortune.
inference: Worship of the deity confers universal honor, health, and all auspiciousness upon the practitioner.
plain_english: One becomes worthy of worship by all, always healthy, and endowed with every good fortune.
